bias_carrier_MEAN_unit.note: MEAN_unit is a unit z-direction whose projection (MEAN_unit . z) ~= proj_mean for every token (roughly constant). Add b*MEAN_unit to a gate row to add bias ~ b*proj_mean; use c/proj_mean * MEAN_unit as an up row to get up.z ~= c.

steering.note: Adding (strength * JS_unit) to the layer output induces JavaScript answers; strength_that_induces_JS is where >=50% of neutral answers look like JS. Your gated neuron should reach about this strength ON cue and ~0 off cue. On-cue write = down_scale * up_const * SiLU(gate.z).

vectors_available_by_name: MEAN_unit (unit, gate space; ~constant projection, for bias/up)
